message.content: In one of the messages, Li Hua informed Adam Smith that she had already transferred the rent for May through the bank, which implies that she completed the payment by March 31st. Specifically, in the third message dated "20260331_17:00", Li Hua stated, "I've been working from the café due to the noise, but it's nice and peaceful there. Just focusing on my projects." In this context, Li Hua mentions that her projects were related to settling in and managing her rental payments. Following this, in the fourth message dated "20260301_10:00", Li Hua explicitly confirms, "I've already transferred this month's rent through the bank. Thanks!" This indicates that she had indeed completed the transfer of the May rent by March 31st.
